current.reason: Night flash photo of a rowi kiwi on Blumine Island (not Okarito place); only 523px wide; subject is an animal not the named place.

candidates.reason: Cat Ōkārito Lagoon, 2017. Calm blue lagoon with old wharf pilings, cormorant, mirror reflection and Southern Alps behind; instantly reads as Okarito wetland/kayaking. 4032px, 4:3, subject central.
Genuine Okarito Lagoon, but the view is dark bush and distant snowy peaks with a thin strip of water; no lagoon or hamlet recognisable. Weaker than MRD 05.

Quality image, cat Ōkārito Lagoon, coords at Okarito. Lagoon, old wharf shed on piles, mud flats and bush; the iconic Okarito wharf shed. Sky large, somewhat flat, so second choice. (Listed name 2017-11-21 Okarito Lagoon 12.jpg no longer exists; renamed Okarito Lagoon 12.jpg.)
Same wharf shed, but foreground is a large empty gravel bank under blank blue sky; flat composition. (Original listed name no longer exists; renamed Okarito Lagoon 06.jpg.)
Two holiday houses on a bush hillside; building close-up, not the hamlet or lagoon in its setting; Flickr-origin with '© Fou 16' watermark text in corner.

Genuine drone view of Okarito township and surf beach, coords match. Recognisable but aerial, overcast and houses dominate; ground-level lagoon shot is a stronger spot image. Acceptable fallback only.
